description: Authorisation record for one witness key (oev-witness-authorization/0.1, HEA design §9.2). Issued by the operator that owns the witness key; the offline HEA verifier checks it when supplied (and refuses when --require-witness-authorization is set and it is missing). An empty authorized_profiles list authorises NO profile (fail-closed); authorized_checks, when present, restricts the check_ids the key may attest — an empty list authorises no check, an absent field means no check restriction.
title: OEVP Witness Authorization
